questions.questionText:
Seven boxes Box P, Box Q, Box R, Box S, Box T, Box U, Box V are placed one above another in a vertical stack. From bottom (position 1) to top (position 7), the order is:
Box T, Box V, Box P, Box Q, Box S, Box U, Box R.
Which box is kept at the bottommost position?
questions.hint: Trace the stack from bottom (1) to top (7). "Immediately above" means position + 1.
questions.explanation: The bottommost box is at position 1. Reading the vertical stack from bottom to top, Box T is at the bottommost position.
solutionSteps: Step 1: Number the stack 1 (bottom) to 7 (top).
Step 2: Place each box according to the vertical sequence.
Step 3: Read the required relative position: Box T.
questions.memoryTip: Box Stacks: "Immediately above" = +1 position; "Between A and B" = Absolute difference of positions minus 1.

Box T, Box S, Box U, Box V, Box P, Box R, Box Q.
How many boxes are kept between Box S and Box R?
questions.hint: Trace the stack from bottom (1) to top (7). "Immediately above" means position + 1.
questions.explanation: Box Box S is at position 2 and Box R is at position 6. The boxes between them are at positions 3, 4, and 5 (Box U, Box V, Box P), making exactly 3 boxes.
solutionSteps: Step 1: Number the stack 1 (bottom) to 7 (top).
Step 2: Place each box according to the vertical sequence.
Step 3: Read the required relative position: 3 boxes.
questions.memoryTip: Box Stacks: "Immediately above" = +1 position; "Between A and B" = Absolute difference of positions minus 1.

Box S, Box U, Box R, Box V, Box T, Box Q, Box P.
Which box is kept immediately above Box R?
questions.hint: Trace the stack from bottom (1) to top (7). "Immediately above" means position + 1.
questions.explanation: Box R is at position 3 in the stack. The box immediately above it at position 4 is Box V.
solutionSteps: Step 1: Number the stack 1 (bottom) to 7 (top).
Step 2: Place each box according to the vertical sequence.
Step 3: Read the required relative position: Box V.
questions.memoryTip: Box Stacks: "Immediately above" = +1 position; "Between A and B" = Absolute difference of positions minus 1.
